reason: Repo hygiene, no runtime behaviour: GitHub issue forms + PR template + commit-subject enforcement for the contribution conventions that previously lived only in CONTRIBUTING.md prose. Adds .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/ (freeform + design-anchored forms, blank issues disabled, two shape labels auto-applied), .github/pull_request_template.md, .githooks/ (commit-msg + pre-push via scripts/check_commit_subject.py, installed by the new `make hooks`; both hooks resolve the checker against the committing worktree via --show-toplevel and run stdlib python3, and pre-push checks every commit in the pushed range, capped at 200/ref), declares the seven de-facto commit types (design/config/build/style/ci/ops/doctrine) plus perf/security, retires the superseded `Merge <branch>:` merge-subject generation, and rejects a `merge:` subject with an empty arc or a GitHub-default body behind the authored prefix. CONTRIBUTING.md carries the measurements behind each rule; the review round that found the hook-resolution and disguise defects is recorded in PR #246 comments.
